title: ringswim-dl2 with the label-free local drive: cells from noise swim and divide on a clean tree genealogy (145-148 persistent splits, 0 merges, 2 seeds at 256^2) and need their ring to live (chi=0: extinct), but the ring is weaker (labkit 1.36-1.38) than with the label drive
summary: Interim result of my C:swim-divide campaign. The claim world (20261025T2209) with c07's kernel drive instead of the per-body label average: at mu=1.5 cells become box-wrapping bands; at mu=0.75 and waste kd=0.08 a bounded population forms from noise on fresh seeds 3-4 at 256^2 with 145-148 persistent splits and no merges, 82-90 tracks swimming >= 3 body lengths, and 5-11 lineages that swim >= 3 BL ringed and divide into ringed daughters (contour ring score median 1.59, >= 1.5 in 87% of scored frames). chi=0 kills every cell by t~1000. But labkit's aggregate ring is 1.36-1.38, below the gate, and small cells leave 60% of frames unscored, so B with a local drive is not established.

finding.operator: label-free Gaussian-kernel phoretic drive on chi-ringed Allen-Cahn cells
finding.control: chi=0 on seed 3 (extinct); mu=1.5 and 3 at 128^2 (bands)
